svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Multi-cloud with a shared identity provider subtitle: One Okta tenant signs users in to AWS, Google Cloud and Azure; private interconnects meet at a colocation router direction: down # Compact spacing and short network labels keep the three frames side by side under 1140px, # so the labels stay readable in an 880px README column. layout: { merge: false, spacing: compact } legend: solid: Network link, traffic both ways dashed: Federated sign-in groups: aws: { type: aws:cloud } aws-region: { type: aws:region, label: us-east-1, in: aws } aws-vpc: { type: aws:vpc, label: VPC 10.10.0.0/16, in: aws-region } gcloud: { type: gcp:cloud } gcp-project: { type: gcp:project, label: Project analytics, in: gcloud } gcp-vpc: { type: gcp:vpc, label: VPC network, in: gcp-project } tenant: { type: azure:tenant, label: Microsoft Entra tenant } azure: { type: azure:subscription, label: Azure subscription, in: tenant } azure-rg: { type: azure:resource-group, label: rg-partner-portal, in: azure } azure-vnet: { type: azure:vnet, label: VNet 10.20.0.0/16, in: azure-rg } nodes: idp: { icon: logos:okta-icon, label: Okta, note: Workforce identity } orders: { icon: aws:eks, label: Amazon EKS, note: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service, in: aws-vpc } dxgw: { icon: aws:direct-connect-gateway, label: Direct Connect gateway, in: aws-region } analytics: { icon: gcp:bigquery, label: BigQuery, note: Analytics, in: gcp-project } cloud-router: { icon: gcp:cloud-router, label: Cloud Router, in: gcp-vpc } portal: { icon: azure:app-service, label: Azure App Service, note: Partner portal, in: azure-rg } pe: { icon: azure:private-endpoint, label: Private endpoint, note: App Service, in: azure-vnet } # Beside the private endpoint, so the Azure frame is no deeper than the other two. er-gw: { icon: azure:virtual-network-gateways, label: ExpressRoute gateway, in: azure-vnet, align: pe } # The circuits sit outside the cloud frames, as in the hybrid examples. dx: { icon: aws:direct-connect, label: AWS Direct Connect } interconnect: { icon: gcp:partner-interconnect, label: Partner Interconnect } er: { icon: azure:expressroute, label: Azure ExpressRoute } router: { icon: generic:router, label: Colocation router, note: BGP to every cloud } edges: # Federation lands on the AWS and Google Cloud frames as a whole and on the Microsoft Entra tenant # that holds the Azure subscription, so the edges end at the group borders. - idp --> aws: SAML - idp --> gcloud: OIDC - idp --> tenant: SAML # Every link that leaves a frame names how it joins: the attachment inside, the circuit outside. - orders -- dxgw: VGW association - dxgw -- dx: private VIF - analytics -- cloud-router: Private Google Access - cloud-router -- interconnect: VLAN attachment - portal -- pe: Private Link - pe -- er-gw - er-gw -- er: connection - dx -- router: cross-connect - interconnect -- router: service provider - er -- router: private peering

svg.title: Multi-cloud with a shared identity provider
svg.desc: Multi-cloud with a shared identity provider. 12 components in 10 groups. Connections: Okta to AWS Cloud (SAML); Okta to Google Cloud (OIDC); Okta to Microsoft Entra tenant (SAML); Amazon EKS to Direct Connect gateway (VGW association); Direct Connect gateway to AWS Direct Connect (private VIF); BigQuery to Cloud Router (Private Google Access); Cloud Router to Partner Interconnect (VLAN attachment); Azure App Service to Private endpoint (Private Link); Private endpoint to ExpressRoute gateway; ExpressRoute gateway to Azure ExpressRoute (connection); AWS Direct Connect to Colocation router (cross-connect); Partner Interconnect to Colocation router (service provider); Azure ExpressRoute to Colocation router (private peering).

text.tspan: MULTI-CLOUD WITH A SHARED IDENTITY PROVIDER
One Okta tenant signs users in to AWS, Google Cloud and Azure; private interconnects meet at a colocation router
